correctness.rationale: The exact state (k,l) recurrence partitions all admissible edges. One-tag and two-tag avoidance probabilities are explicitly counted; their k-monotonicity and sharp rational bounds were symbolically checked. Two-tag union control isolates the single-tag final step, and a telescoping product proves nq_n→3/4 and O(n^(-1/3)) error for every n→infinity. Separate fully labeled exact recurrence checks n=2..7. Finite computations are not substituted for the limiting proof.

value.rationale: The graph K_{2,2,...,2} has abundant perfect matchings, yet random sequential irreversible adsorption can leave a forbidden pair unoccupied. Deriving the exact kinetic jam probability and sharp universal coefficient 3/4 for this natural highly connected family resolves a meaningful non-equilibrium finite-size defect law; a two-pair survival argument supplies the nontrivial rate and separates kinetics from static enumeration.
